text: Standard merchandise may be returned within 30 days of the delivery date for a full refund, provided the item is unused and in its original packaging.
Electronics, including TVs, headphones, and audio equipment, carry a 15-day return window from delivery. Items must be free of physical damage and include all original accessories.
Clothing and footwear can be returned within 45 days of delivery as long as tags remain attached and the item shows no signs of wear.
Home appliances are covered by a 30-day return window. Appliances that arrive defective or stop functioning within that period qualify for a full refund or replacement regardless of usage.
Items marked as final sale, including select designer and clearance goods, are not eligible for return or refund under any circumstances.
Any item that arrives damaged or defective may be returned within 90 days of delivery for a full refund or replacement, independent of the standard category return window.
Refund claims exceeding 500 dollars, or accounts with two or more prior disputes, must be reviewed by a member of the human support team before a refund is issued.
